assignedTasks.title: Establish 5-Week Milestone Tracking
assignedTasks.description:
Set up project management structure to track the 5-week plan. Requirements:
1. Milestone definitions for Week 1 (Foundation) through Week 5 (Polish).
2. Weekly progress reports for the 'Let\'s Talk' stakeholders.
3. Dependency tracking (Backend completion vs Frontend integration).

assignedTasks.title: Risk Management: Performance & Design
assignedTasks.description:
Monitor technical risks specifically related to the 'Midnight Glass' UI. Requirements:
1. Track browser performance issues due to heavy backdrop-filter usage.
2. Ensure PWA compatibility across low-end mobile devices.
3. Mitigate delays in real-time chat implementation by coordinating fullstack deliverables.

assignedTasks.title: Final Documentation & Handover Prep
assignedTasks.description:
Gather all technical specs into a final project manual. Requirements:
1. API Documentation summary.
2. Component usage guide for future maintenance.
3. PWA Deployment guide (Vercel/Netlify + SSL setup).
